resources.string: %1$s counts what\'s new: likes, comments, friend requests and news from your device. %2$s has your profile, password and language, and %3$s to see this again.
This phone copies its photos and videos to your device by itself. Under %1$s you choose what it sends, and %2$s keeps it off mobile data.
Select photos and choose %1$s, then %2$s, to keep them together, like a trip. The button next to the search lists your collections: open one to rename, share or delete it.
Select photos in Images and choose %1$s, then %2$s, to keep them together, like a trip. Open a collection here to rename it, share it as a gallery or delete it.
Photos are grouped by month, newest first. Drag your finger down the right edge of the photos to jump to any month: the date shows as you go.
The button beside the folder\'s path switches between %1$s, %2$s and %3$s, which shows what takes up space. Under %4$s, pick an order, and pick it again to reverse it.
The two-people button at the top opens Friends: share your address there, or type a friend\'s device name under %1$s and tap %2$s. A request to you waits under %3$s: tap %4$s.
Share your address so friends can add you, or type their device\'s name under %1$s and tap %2$s. A request to you waits under %3$s: tap %4$s.
The button next to the search opens People: tap a face to see every photo of that person, or %1$s to name them. Two faces of one person? Press and hold one, tap the other and choose %2$s.
Tap a face to see every photo of that person, or %1$s to name them. Two faces of one person? Press and hold one, tap the other and choose %2$s.
Tap +, pick photos or videos from %1$s (this phone) or %2$s (already on your device), write a caption and tap %3$s. It goes from your device to your friends\' devices.
Type a thing or a place to find photos, or part of a file\'s name to find it in Files. Each pick for photos shows as a chip; tap its × to remove it.
Type a thing, a place or someone\'s name to find photos, or part of a file\'s name to find it in Files. Each pick for photos shows as a chip; tap its × to remove it.
Press and hold a photo, then drag across others to select them too. Then choose %1$s, %2$s, %3$s or %4$s in the bar at the bottom.
A short tour of how to search, sort and share your photos and files, post to Social and add friends.
Your posts and your friends\' show here, newest first. Tap the heart to like one, write under it to comment, and tap the number of likes to see who liked it.

%1$s adds files from this phone to the open folder; select some with their circles to %2$s a link or %3$s them. The lock beside a folder makes it upload only: nothing in it can be deleted and old versions are kept.
Keep %1$s on to give them their own address.
Give each person their own Off The Cloud on this same device: their own photos, files and private feed, separate from yours. In %1$s › %2$s, type a username, tap %3$s and set their first password.
Tap a photo to open it, then swipe to go through them. The %1$s button (ⓘ) shows when and where it was taken, the camera and a map.
